title: Promote 8 Review
eyebrow: PR #675 · development → staging · wave 8 + review fix
intro_html:
This promote moves wave 8 of the shared-building-blocks refactor (PR #674) and one review-fix commit onto staging. Most of it reorganises code so charts, EVE images, systems, account forms and page metadata each have one home. A handful of those changes are visible, and they are shown below with screenshots of staging today next to the same screen after this promote.

Screens come from two local servers running the old and new code against the same local data. Where a change only shows with live EVE data, the local data was mocked (blocked image server, stubbed responses, a seeded character state). Each caption says so.

next_html:
What happens when you are happy

Tell me if anything here should change first. Once you say go, I merge PR #675 into staging with a merge commit (all checks are already green on its head), then start the same write-up for wave 9.

sections.title: Charts
sections.lede: Trend and daily charts join the net-worth chart in being readable by keyboard, and a click or tap no longer jumps the readout.

sections.title: EVE images and the board
sections.lede: Logos, item icons and the portrait rail now come from shared pieces, with a few small visible fixes.

sections.title: Systems and industry
sections.lede: Security status gets one look everywhere, and system names recover by themselves when the system list fails to load.

sections.title: Account, admin and sign-in
sections.lede: Shared form and status pieces. One visible change on the admin user page; the rest is invisible or for screen readers.

sections.title: Page metadata and link previews
sections.lede: What Discord, X and search engines see when someone shares an industry or site link.

P010 (unknown-security pill).title: The composer's security pill shows grey instead of red when a system's security is unknown
P010 (unknown-security pill).settled: No system in the current EVE data has unknown security (all 8,089 have a value), so this never shows today. The screenshot fakes an unknown value to show what it would look like.

P271a.settled: You approved the standard share card for industry pages.

captions.p012-admin-user-delayed: Admin user page, Linked characters card, for a character whose EVE verification has been failing for over a day. Before: no status tag. After: the orange 'Verification delayed' tag, matching Settings. (Local data mocked.)
captions.p012-settings-delayed: Settings › Characters with the same mocked state. Identical before and after: Settings already showed 'Verification delayed' and its warning box, and the new shared rule gives the same result. (Local data mocked: the test character's EVE verification marked as failing for two days.)
captions.p318-all-zero-chart: Net-worth chart for a pilot holding 0 ISK: the lower ISK axis now reads -1.00 / 0.00 / 1.00 instead of fractions of an ISK (-0.10 / 0.10). The flat line and everything else are unchanged. (Demo board data edited to 0 ISK in a throwaway copy of the code.)
captions.p318-all-zero-balance-trend: Wallet balance chart for an all-zero balance: the y-axis now shows -1.00 / 0.00 / 1.00 gridlines where it used to show a single 0.00 label. The flat line sits in the same place. (Demo board data edited to an all-zero balance in a throwaway copy of the code.)
